docs.text: the block at the very top of a note, between two --- lines, is its front matter. --- title : a custom title (otherwise the first heading is used) stage : seedling tags : [ idea , book ] planted : 2026-11-10 tended : 2026-11-10 links_to : [ another note , a third note ] template : home.html width : full # draft: true # aliases: [old-note-name] --- stage shows a colored badge: seedling , bud or evergreen tags show as pills under the title and link to their section on the by-tag page; search for notes by tag with #tag links_to adds links to other notes by title or filename, even if the text doesn't link to them planted and tended show as dates, and tended sorts the "recently tended" widget template: home.html is only for your homepage; it enables the stats, note of the day, recent notes, clock, stage legend and garden graph widgets width: full widens the page content; this reference page uses it draft: true keeps a note out of the built site aliases creates redirect pages for old note paths
docs.title: page metadata

docs.text: the homepage's how to read this garden widget explains the seedling, bud and evergreen stages the index , random and style buttons are at the upper left of the header; style switches between light and dark mode the search field is at the upper right. Press / outside a text field to focus it. Use #tag in a search to find notes with that tag. on pages with a table of contents, use the drawer on the right to open or collapse it
